text:
maria (Finance): Heads up — GCP posted a retroactive credit on the Feb invoice: -$12,340 landed as a single negative line on project `redwood-playground-prod`. That zeroed-out the playground pool and our chargeback pipeline choked. @sam @jin can you advise?

sam (Infra): Is this a vendor credit or did their billing platform correct something? :eyes:

maria (Finance): Vendor-side correction — GCP said they reversed an overcharge on spot preemptions. Finance saw the negative line and our allocator applied it to the project, which wiped out team allocations for Feb. Snippet from the invoice: ```
PROJECT: redwood-playground-prod
LINE: Retroactive credit -$12,340.00
CODE: CREDIT_REV_2026_02
```

jin (ML): Oof. Can we re-run allocation to pro-rate the credit across the tags that originally consumed the spend? Our usual rule is to apportion credits by tag-weight for that month (by token-hours). Example formula: ```credit_share = tag_spend / total_project_spend * total_credit```

sam (Infra): We have a repro script: `scripts/alloc_pro_rata.py --month=2026-02 --project=playground-prod --credit=-12340` but it currently errors on negative credits (edge-case). I'll patch tonight and run a re-attribution. :hammer_and_wrench:

maria (Finance): Before you run anything, need approval to apply retro adjustment to team budgets. @tara — do we absorb into central pool or push adjustments back to teams? This will change Feb reported spend per team.

tara (Finance Lead): Recommend absorbing into the central infra credit pool for one-off vendor corrections like this, then notify impacted teams and adjust March budgets so no surprise. Also let's add a review rule: any retroactive credit > $5k triggers manual approval and a short notes field on the invoice. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Automated note: Created ticket INV-2026-0227 for retro credit allocation and manual review. Link: <https://payments.redwood/INV-2026-0227>

sam (Infra): OK — I'll open a small PR to handle negative credits and run the re-attribution tonight. Will paste the per-team delta table here once done.

maria (Finance): Thanks — once PR runs, please include the CSV output so we can ingest into the cost reporting pipeline and send comms to teams.

sam (Infra): Will do.

maria (Finance): Thanks everyone!
